_source: User adjudications 2026-05-20 and 2026-10-19 (D-001, D-008), citing Rules of Play 1.3.1, 4.6.1, and Errata FAQ #1.
_note: Sail (4.6.1 / FAQ #1) permits direct Port/Exile-to-Port travel only within the same Sea; cross-Sea travel requires an at-Sea transit; Irish Sea and North Sea are NOT directly adjacent (transit via the English Channel). Exile boxes act similarly to a Port per 1.3.1. Great Ships (Y6) collapses cross-Sea distance only for Parley, Tax, and Supply - NOT for Sail (FAQ #1).
